mapper.update:
UPDATE task_instance
SET status = 'RUNNING',
lease_owner = #{workerId},
lease_until = DATE_ADD( UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND ),
lease_version = lease_version + 1,
started_at = COALESCE( started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
WHERE id = #{instanceId}
AND status = 'QUEUED'
AND ( next_run_at IS NULL OR next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.select:
SELECT ti.id AS instanceId, ti.definition_id AS definitionId, ti.scheduled_at AS scheduledAt, ti.retry_count AS retryCount, ti.lease_version AS leaseVersion, ti.lease_owner AS workerId,
td.handler_type AS handlerType, CAST(td.payload AS CHAR) AS payload, td.max_retries AS maxRetries
FROM task_instance ti
JOIN task_definition td ON ti.definition_id = td.id
WHERE ti.id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_instance ( definition_id, user_id, scheduled_at, status, handler_type, payload, max_retries ) VALUES ( #{definitionId}, #{userId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status}, #{handlerType}, CAST(#{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON), #{maxRetries} )
